name: Amamiya Karan
source: An outgoing girl enrolled at Seishou Academy. Extremely athletic, she's frequently called in to help with the various sports clubs. She's a member of the cheerleading club and is popular with the male students. She's righteous and despises molesters. Her hobbies include watching baseball and eating Ramen on the go.
